name: Seat reversal
task: Two players assign pressure/support roles, then reverse seats while holding deck contents fixed. Compare opening options and lost field exposure; no assumed first-turn rule.

name: Handoff test
task: Use a hypothetical three-field state. Compare remaining in place versus withdrawal, considering the intervening opponent's choices and dated scoring constraints.

name: Distributed budget
task: Give each partner abstract spending capacity of three units. A proposed development costs two each; a later defensive response needs two from one partner. Compare reserving resources versus symmetric spending; units are abstract, not Riftbound costs.

name: Archetype misread
task: Opponents infer a narrow gear payoff from a revealed Legend. Track how the team changes sideboard coverage when they observe a conflicting public cue. No banned payoff used as current legal threat.

name: Shared accountability
task: Two partners make different predictions about a threatening position. Write down their reasons before the result; review whether the outcome disproves either premise.

name: Clock checkpoint
task: Compare a slow and fast plan at a hypothetical score deficit with limited time. Verify applicable tournament end procedure before using real scores.

name: Wording trap
task: Build two abstract effects, one controller-limited and one ally-inclusive; test that each selects only the permitted objects. Do not treat invented effects as actual cards.

name: Combo failure
task: List a fragile team payoff's necessary conditions and remove one at a time; retain an independent fallback and record why a proposed route fails.
